title: Not my favorite
text: Not my favorite. Shouldn't have ordered this in the height of summer. It came very melted and all the wax was running lengthwise in jar vs on the bottom. I manually mushed it back into bottom of jar. The fragrance is very bold and stayed on my hands for 24 hrs. The sound of the wick crackling makes me nervous. And I'm always looking to see what's on fire. Won't reorder this. And I'll stick to classic candles from now on.

description: The Nature’s Wick Smoked Vanilla 10-oz. Scented Candle fills your home with inviting scents and a soft crackle. This jarred candle features a natural wooden wick that's designed to ensure faster scent dispersion and a better burn while fragrancing your home, along with the soothing sound of a crackling fire. The 10-ounce candle can burn for up to 65 hours and comes with a wooden lid to blend into your home's décor.
